title: feat(app-shell): FlowRunner reads the flows option-label and terminal-toast keys (objectui#12075)
body:
Fixes #12075
Clause-②: no

The screen-flow runner now reads the three `flows` translation keys objectstack#22507 published, and draws the served screen heading as served (ruling A on objectstack#22507, folded into this card by comments 6093869675 / 6095081088).

## What changed

- **Option labels** (`flows.FLOW.screens.NODE.fields.FIELD.options.VALUE`). `FlowRunner`'s `localizeScreen` hands each field to the spec's `resolveFlowScreenFieldOptions` before `ScreenView` draws its items. Not through `FLOW_SCREEN_FIELD_COPY_KEYS`. An option the bundle does not address keeps its authored label.
- **The flow's own toasts** (`flows.FLOW.successMessage` / `errorMessage`). They are translated in ONE place, `interpretFlowResponse` in `utils/flowResponse.ts`. That is where both strings come off the wire. It takes an optional `FlowCopyLocale` (flow name, the active `flows` bundle, its locale) and answers the `done` arm's `successMessage` and `flowFailureMessage`'s authored `errorMessage` through the spec's `translateFlow`. Each falls back to the served string.
  - `FlowRunner`'s resume passes its run's flow and bundle, so the terminal-success toast (by `flowSuccessCopy`) and the failure toast and inline alert read the translation.
  - **The launch path is handed the bundle and the flow name.** `launchConsoleFlow` takes a new `translation: { i18n, language }`. It reads the bundle for the flow the run belongs to (the declared action's `target` on the action door, the clicked flow on the trigger route) and passes it into `interpretFlowResponse`. Both hosts pass it: `useConsoleActionRuntime`'s and `RecordDetailView`'s flow handlers, with `i18n` / `language` added to their `useCallback` deps. A straight-through run's `successToast` (objectui#12274) and a failed launch's ActionRunner error therefore read the translation too.
  - Only what the flow authors is translated. `translateFlow` overlays a toast only where one is served, so a bundle never adds one. The engine's own `error` prose has no key and is passed through.
- **The bundle reader moved to `utils/flowsBundle.ts`** (`activeFlowsBundle`, unchanged). There are now two readers, `FlowRunner` and `flowLaunch`. Module-internal, not re-exported.
- **Ruling A: the runner stops overlaying the screen `title`.** The `resolveFlowScreenTitle` call and import are gone. No `description` overlay is added. The header's "Deliberately NOT localized" list is rewritten, along with the client-side-pick boundary note, the `localizeScreen` docblock and the JSX comment. The old list said `FlowSchema.successMessage` is off the translation surface, which is now wrong. It also said `inlineHelpText` is outside `FLOW_SCREEN_FIELD_COPY_KEYS`, which has been stale since objectstack#17306 (the installed constant is `label`, `placeholder`, `inlineHelpText`). After this change, `resolveFlowScreenTitle` has no caller in this repo.
- **A3: a select binds the option's own value** (`ScreenView.tsx`, `ScreenFieldInput`). Measured on a real render: it was a real wrong value. The fix is local, so it lands here with a pin. Items are still addressed by the value read as text, now through the spec's `flowScreenFieldOptionKey`. On change, the field binds the matching option's declared `value`. The spec refuses two options that collide as text, so the match is unique.

## A3, the measurement

The pin `resumes with the number and the boolean the picked options declare` (`FlowRunner.flowsTranslation-12075.test.tsx`) drives the real Radix select inside a mounted `FlowRunner`, submits, and reads the resume request body. With the fix ablated (the `pickOption` handler swapped back for one that hands the item's text straight to `onChange`; both marker counts verified on disk before and after), the pin fails:

```
     × resumes with the number and the boolean the picked options declare
-   "notify": false,
-   "tier": 2,
+   "notify": "false",
+   "tier": "2",
      Tests  1 failed | 8 passed (9)
```

The restore leg was `git checkout HEAD -- ABS_PATH`. It was proven by an empty `git diff HEAD` and a matching HEAD blob hash.

## Reverse verification of the translation reads

I mutated two lines at once:
- `overlayFieldOptions` always returns the field;
- `translatedFlowMessage` always returns the served string.

Both marker counts were 1 on disk. With the mutation, 9 pins fail across the three suites: both option-label pins, the runner's success and error toast pins, both `launchConsoleFlow` pins and three `interpretFlowResponse` pins. `Tests  9 failed | 51 passed (60)`. The restore was proven the same way (diff empty, hashes match).

## Tests and gates (final head 5b02025)

- **Every test file that names a touched module, 221 files.** I took them from a `git grep -l` of the test files for `FlowRunner`, `ScreenView`, `flowResponse`, `flowLaunch`, `useConsoleActionRuntime`, `RecordDetailView`, `flowsBundle` and `ScreenFieldInput`, across `packages/**` and `apps/**`. They ran under the verify lock at cdb61c5 (the last source commit): `Test Files  3 failed | 218 passed (221)`, `Tests  4 failed | 2051 passed (2055)`. All four failures were pins of the retired heading overlay, or a literal read of the line this diff widened:
  - `apps/console/src/loadLanguage.test.tsx` ("a flows-only bundle — the wizard draws the translation");
  - `FlowRunner.flowLabel-11092` (two heading assertions);
  - `packages/i18n/.../residue-namespaces-3546` (it read RecordDetailView's `const { t, language } = useObjectTranslation();` verbatim).

  5b02025 re-points them: the bundle channel is now proven by a field label, the served heading is asserted, and the binding is read by the sibling pattern. Those three files plus the four below ran at 5b02025: `Test Files  7 passed (7)`, `Tests  122 passed (122)`. The commits after cdb61c5 touch test files only.
- The new and changed pins at 5b02025: `FlowRunner.flowsTranslation-12075`, `FlowRunner.flowsTranslation-5920`, `utils/__tests__/flowResponse.test.ts`, `utils/__tests__/flowLaunch.translation-12075.test.ts` (in the 7-file run above).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) exits 0. This was after `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell^...` (28/28 tasks). `--listFilesOnly` confirms the test program includes all four test files.
- ESLint on the 14 changed TS/TSX files, `--no-inline-config`: 0 errors. All warnings are pre-existing `no-explicit-any` / `exhaustive-deps` / `react-hooks` warnings in the touched host files. Type-aware linting is not configured (no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService` in `eslint.config.js`), so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
- Pre-tsc battery, all exit 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `control-bytes`, `new-line-citations`. Also `node scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs` and `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`.
- `check:spec-floors` exits 1 for the unrelated reason already tracked in objectui#12334 ("The scan collapsed: 0 package(s) declare @objectstack/spec…").

## Acceptance notes

- `interpretFlowResponse`'s new `copy` parameter is optional. Without it, both toasts come back as served. The existing ~30 test call sites pass no bundle and are unchanged. Both production callers pass one.
- No `content/docs` page or package README describes the runner's translation reads, so no doc moves with this change.
- `Clause-②: no`, measured. `FlowRunner`, `FlowRunnerProps`, `ScreenFlowState` and `ScreenSpec` / `ScreenFieldSpec` are the package-entry exports in this area, and none of them changed. `flowResponse`, `flowLaunch` and `flowsBundle` are not re-exported.
- The engine half (objectstack `d25b187203`) and the keys half (`f89b5f561`) are both ancestors of `@objectstack/spec@18.0.0-next.0`, the version this lockfile resolves (triage comment 6163410517). The installed `dist` carries `resolveFlowScreenFieldOptions`, `FLOW_TERMINAL_MESSAGE_KEYS`, `translateFlow`'s toast keys and `flowScreenFieldOptionKey`. I read them before building.

Changeset: `.changeset/12075-flow-runner-translations.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell: minor`.
